origin: ts.mbt — found by the new output verifier (docs/type-aware-dce.md E1) on Excalidraw's StoreDelta.load
what: A class method's destructuring parameter could not be represented in `TsClassMethodDecl.params`, so the class lift kept the first bound name and dropped the pattern. `flat({left, right})` became `flat(left)` (ReferenceError) and `nested({inner: {deep}})` became `nested(deep)`, which returns the argument object instead of throwing. The pattern is now desugared into the body (`m(__pat0) { const {left, right} = __pat0; … }`), so arity is unchanged — `arity` in the report pins that. The keys are read by the caller building the argument, so they are ABI too.
